payload.title: Scan hangs on long quoted strings: PATH_OR_PROSE_STRING backtracks cubically
payload.description:
CLI 0.0.28 scan never finishes on dubinc/dub (killed after 30-40 min). One 6 KB .tsx with one inline SVG path takes 18 s. CPU profile: 78% in PATH_OR_PROSE_STRING (src/pii-signals/match-pii-signals.ts:210-211, added in 19ce1d13). Three adjacent [^'"`
]* runs separated by \s, where the class also matches whitespace, so a quoted string that starts with a capital and does not end in .!? backtracks O(n^3). Fix: make the match linear with identical results; audit other regexes in src/pii-signals and src/patterns for the same shape.
